description: Frozen configuration that says HOW a synthetic verification gate stops being a permanent blocker, without ever mutating a signed receipt in place and without ever reinterpreting a synthetic conclusion. Like gate_registry_v1.json this file is configuration, not state: it carries no status, verdict, observation or timestamp of any run, and it deliberately records nothing about which receipts happen to exist today. Motivation: VG-A is deliberately and permanently synthetic=true / conclusion=conservative_unknown. If 'any synthetic hard-gate receipt' were an unconditional NO_GO with no closure path, READY_FOR_G7_REVIEW would be unreachable forever even after RT-017 and RT-023 deliver real capability. The closure path below preserves fail-closed truth while making the exit condition explicit and machine-checkable. The one hash literal in this file, pinned_current_receipt_sha256, is not an observation: it is the frozen identity of the single receipt VG-A is permitted to ever have.
closure_rule: 'Never upgraded' has three distinct, non-negotiable meanings and none of them forbids a legitimate fresh gate execution. (1) IMMUTABILITY: a signed receipt artifact is never edited, patched or re-signed in place; see receipt_history_rule. (2) NO REINTERPRETATION: no downstream consumer — RT-024, RT-026, G6, G7 — may read a synthetic=true / conservative_unknown receipt as anything stronger than it says. (3) NO RERUN, for gates with rerun_allowed=false only: VG-A's synthetic scope is permanent because it verified the RT-015 host chain against a FakeSigningAuthority, so VG-A's current receipt is frozen forever, pinned by hash below, and its residual capability gap is closed exclusively by the separately owned capability activation receipts mapped here and cross-listed in SG-00 of the central plan. Once every required activation receipt is present and fully valid, the synthetic VG is no longer by itself a permanent blocker; it stays scoped evidence with an explicit production caveat.
receipt_history_rule: The receipt at a gate's registry receipt_path is the CURRENT receipt and is the only one any consumer reads. For gates with rerun_allowed=true, a fresh gate execution may publish a new current receipt at that same receipt_path, but only after the superseded receipt has been copied byte-identically to gate-receipts/VG-{X}/archive/{superseded receipt_sha256}.json. The archive is append-only and each archived filename IS that receipt's own domain-separated hash, so silent tampering with history is detectable by recomputation. The new current receipt must carry supersedes_receipt_sha256 equal to the newest archived receipt's hash and a strictly later created_at. For gates with rerun_allowed=false there is no rotation at all: the archive directory must be absent or empty, the current receipt must never carry supersedes_receipt_sha256, and its receipt_sha256 must equal pinned_current_receipt_sha256. Under no circumstances is an existing signed artifact mutated in place, at receipt_path or in the archive.
chain_rule: A gate's history is a single linear append-only chain and is verified mechanically, never from prose. NOT_RUN iff receipt_path is absent; a NOT_RUN gate must also have an absent or empty archive. Otherwise: (a) the current receipt must be present and fully valid against the VG receipt schema, registry allowlist, recomputed receipt_sha256 and on-disk artifact hashes; (b) every file in the archive directory must be named <its own recomputed receipt_sha256>.json, must be schema-valid, and must carry the same gate_id as the current receipt; (c) SEQUENCE is the primary ordering proof — the archived receipts plus the current receipt must occupy exactly the integers 1..N with no gap, no duplicate and no orphan, and the current receipt must be the tip at sequence=N; (d) sequence=1 forbids supersedes_receipt_sha256, and sequence=k>1 requires supersedes_receipt_sha256 to equal the recomputed receipt_sha256 of the archived receipt at sequence k-1, so the walk from the tip backwards visits every receipt exactly once with no fork, orphan or cycle; (e) created_at must strictly increase from sequence 1 to N, as an AUXILIARY cross-check that catches backdating — it is never accepted as the ordering proof on its own; (f) rerun_allowed=false gates admit only the first-run shape: absent or empty archive, no supersedes_receipt_sha256, and receipt_sha256 == pinned_current_receipt_sha256. VG-A is the pinned legacy exception: its receipt predates sequence and must NOT be rewritten to add it. Any deviation is INVALID, which fails closed exactly like NOT_RUN and never resolves to CLOSED.
evaluation_rule: Gap state is derived from the CURRENT receipt on disk, never from a caller-supplied flag. If the gate is NOT_RUN or its history is INVALID under chain_rule, the gap is OPEN. If the current receipt has synthetic=false AND conclusion != conservative_unknown, the gap is CLOSED. Otherwise RT-026 resolves closure_mode from gate_closure below. capability_activation_receipts: every id in required_capability_ids must resolve to a CURRENT activation receipt that is present at its declared activation_receipt_path, has a valid history chain under activation_history_rule, is unexpired under activation_expiry_rule, satisfies 0 < (expires_at - created_at) <= that capability's max_validity_seconds under activation_validity_bound_rule, binds a tested_subject_commit that is an ancestor of the commit introducing it under activation_subject_binding_rule, and is fully valid under capability_activation_receipt_v1.schema.json plus every semanticRule there — non-synthetic, status=pass, owner_rt_independent_pass=true, conclusion=capability_activated, verifier present and distinct from producer, consumers exactly [RT-026], closes_gate_ids exactly the gates this map maps to that capability, evidence.tests_run>0 with tests_failed=0 and 0<=tests_skipped<=tests_run, every required_evidence_roles role covered by a real evidence_ref, no evidence_ref or artifact pointing under gate-receipts/, and every artifacts[].sha256 plus every evidence_refs[].sha256 matching a safe repo-relative regular file on disk, with a recomputed receipt_sha256 match. Any of those missing, expired or false => gap OPEN => NO_GO. non_synthetic_rerun: the gap closes only when that gate is re-run non-synthetically under receipt_history_rule and chain_rule, so that the CURRENT receipt at receipt_path carries synthetic=false, or when this map is first amended to map that gate to real activation receipts. There is no VG-A precedent and no 'a sibling gate already proved it' shortcut. A gate whose synthetic status is unmapped here is treated as OPEN, never as N/A.
evidence_binding_rule: An activation receipt BINDS evidence that already exists independently of it; it never bootstraps itself. Every artifacts[] and evidence_refs[] entry must be a pre-existing safe repo-relative regular file (no absolute path, no '..', no symlink, no hardlink, no directory, no device) whose sha256 is recomputed from disk at evaluation time. A receipt must never reference its own activation_receipt_path, the activation_receipt_path of any other capability, or ANY file under gate-receipts/ — neither a current VG receipt nor an archived one. Two reasons: a self- or cross-hash reference would make the receipt's own hash an input to itself, and a VG receipt is strictly downstream sibling evidence consumed by RT-026, so binding one would invert the dependency order. In particular VG-B may not appear in cwork-authority-source and VG-D may not appear in gateway-identity-transport. The independent_acceptance_report role must point at the owning RT's own independent acceptance report, which is produced before this receipt and is therefore never downstream of it.
activation_history_rule: An activation receipt is neither write-once-forever nor silently overwritable. Each capability has exactly the same current + append-only archive shape as a rerun_allowed=true gate: activation_receipt_path always holds the CURRENT receipt, superseded receipts are copied byte-identically to <activation_archive_dir>/{superseded receipt_sha256}.json before rotation, the archive is append-only, and each archived filename IS that receipt's own domain-separated hash. Every receipt carries a monotonic sequence starting at 1, and a chain of N receipts occupies exactly the integers 1..N with the current receipt at the tip and the archive holding 1..N-1; sequence>1 requires previous_receipt_sha256 equal to the archived receipt at sequence-1, so the chain is one unique prefix walk with no gap, fork, orphan or cycle. created_at and expires_at must both strictly increase along the chain, as an auxiliary check that catches backdating but never as the ordering proof on its own. Renewal is allowed ONLY after a fresh real probe re-establishing the capability's production_conditions, while the owning RT's independent acceptance is still valid; the owner writes a new current receipt and never mutates a signed one in place. RT-026 reads the CURRENT receipt only, never an archived one.
activation_expiry_rule: Real external capability is time-bounded, so every activation receipt carries expires_at with created_at < expires_at. Expiry is evaluated at evaluation time against the evaluator's clock: a current receipt whose expires_at is in the past is EXPIRED, which leaves the gap OPEN and forces NO_GO exactly like an absent receipt. Expiry is therefore not a dead end — activation_history_rule gives the owner a defined renewal path — and it is never waived by prose, by the presence of an older valid archived receipt, or by a sibling capability still being in date.
activation_validity_bound_rule: expires_at > created_at alone is not enough: an unbounded TTL would let a single probe certify a real external capability for a century and quietly re-create the dead end that expiry was meant to remove. Each capability therefore freezes max_validity_seconds here, and the validator enforces 0 < (expires_at - created_at) <= max_validity_seconds on EVERY receipt in the chain, current and archived alike. The comparison is inclusive at the upper end, so a receipt whose lifetime is exactly max_validity_seconds is VALID; one second more is rejected. A zero or negative lifetime is rejected by the same expression. This bound is a property of the receipt and is checked independently of the evaluator's clock, so a receipt with an absurd TTL is invalid the moment it is written rather than merely expired later. max_validity_seconds may never exceed activation_max_validity_seconds_ceiling, and a receipt may never carry its own TTL policy: the bound lives in this frozen config, not in the artifact it constrains.
activation_not_before_rule: created_at must be no later than the evaluation instant plus activation_max_clock_skew_seconds. The allowance exists to tolerate honest NTP drift between the machine that signed a receipt and the machine evaluating it; it is deliberately small and is never a licence for future-dated evidence. A receipt created_at 2099-01-01 is INVALID at evaluation, not merely unexpired. The evaluation instant is injected rather than read from a baked constant: production derives real UTC now, fixtures pass a deterministic instant.
activation_subject_binding_rule: Every activation receipt binds tested_subject_commit: the exact 40-hex commit the owner's real probe evidence was produced against, frozen BEFORE the receipt exists. The rule is ANCESTRY plus OWNERSHIP, never equality with a moving head. (a) ANCESTRY: tested_subject_commit must be an ancestor of the commit that introduces the receipt file, so evidence binds a frozen earlier subject, the receipt lands in a later evidence-only commit, and reports reference the receipt later still — no two artifacts ever hash each other. (b) OWNERSHIP: tested_subject_commit must be the commit the receipt's own evidence_refs and artifacts were actually produced against, which is what makes 'this evidence is about this code' machine-checkable. It is explicitly NOT required to equal RT-026's final HEAD, or any later merge commit: downstream merges legitimately advance HEAD after a valid probe, and demanding equality would invalidate honest evidence and re-create the dead end. A consumer rejects a receipt whose tested_subject_commit is not an ancestor of the candidate under review, or whose environment_fingerprint does not match the environment being certified, and may never assert freshness it did not mechanically recompute.
activation_owner_scope_rule: tested_subject_commit is bound by ANCESTRY and by OWNER CODE SCOPE. Ancestry: it must be a STRICT ancestor of the derived evidence commit for the receipt file (see evidence_commit_derivation_rule), so the two-commit evidence pattern (subject frozen first, receipt lands later, reports reference the receipt later still) stays acyclic and no two artifacts ever hash each other. Owner code scope: the subject commit must have actually modified at least one path under owner_code_path_prefixes for this capability, matched on exact path boundaries (see path_boundary_rule). owner_code_path_prefixes and owner_evidence_path_prefixes are deliberately DISJOINT: a path under an evidence-output prefix is explicitly disqualified from counting as owner code, because the capability's own capability-receipts/ directory used to be listed as owner scope and a commit that changed nothing but the receipt therefore satisfied 'the subject modified the owning package' -- evidence must never bootstrap its own subject binding. Both are recomputed against the real repository; a 40-hex string that matches the pattern but names no commit is rejected.
activation_report_freeze_rule: the independent_acceptance_report evidence role is FROZEN BEFORE the receipt is issued and is never edited afterwards. Binding a report by hash and then editing that report to add the receipt's own path or hash would invalidate the bound hash and re-create exactly the mutual-reference cycle this design exists to prevent. Only a non-bound delivery/status artifact — one that appears in NO evidence_refs and NO artifacts entry of any activation receipt — may later reference the receipt, and even then the reference is one-way: the report points at the receipt, the receipt never points back.
archive_membership_rule: an archive directory is validated by EXACT MEMBERSHIP, not by globbing '*.json'. Every entry it contains must be a regular file, with exactly one hard link, that is not a symlink, whose name is exactly <64-hex>.json and whose 64-hex stem equals that receipt's own recomputed hash. Any other entry — a junk.txt, a nested directory, a dotfile, a symlink, a hardlink, or a JSON file whose name is not its own hash — invalidates the whole history. Globbing '*.json' silently ignored such entries, which a reviewer showed left VG-A reported VALID with a non-empty archive even though rerun_allowed=false requires that archive to be absent or empty. This rule applies identically to gate archives and activation archives, and the enumeration itself goes through the fail-closed openat/O_NOFOLLOW directory walk.
aggregation_rule: RT-026 only aggregates. It must not create, backfill, guess or Markdown-infer any activation receipt, must not rotate or archive any gate receipt, and must not edit this map. A missing activation receipt is NOT_RUN and fails closed; the absence of a file is never evidence of activation. This file deliberately records NO observation of which receipts currently exist, which capability is currently blocked, or what today's verdict is: every such statement is derived at evaluation time from receipt existence and content, and the human-readable snapshot lives in README/STATUS/feasibility docs only.

capabilities.title: CWork 权威 ACL / 撤权源
capabilities.generation_timing: Produced by RT-017 only after AC-017-01..11 are all evidenced and RT-017's own independent acceptance is PASS, and only if the real authority conditions below hold. It binds RT-017's own PASS plus real authority-source evidence and NOTHING downstream: VG-B is a separate sibling input to RT-026 and is neither a precondition of this receipt nor an admissible evidence role in it. The order is RT-017 independent PASS -> activation receipt -> RT-026, with VG-B running on its own track and RT-026 strictly downstream of both, so the graph is acyclic.
capabilities.max_validity_note: 90 days. A CWork authority snapshot/revocation contract, its AppKey authorization and its audit signature can all change without notice, so a single probe may certify at most one quarter before a fresh real probe is required under activation_history_rule. expires_at - created_at exactly equal to 7776000 is valid; 7776001 is not.
capabilities.closure_condition: 真实权威 ACL 快照 / 撤权事件流 API + 真实凭据接入，并有 RT-017 自身独立验收 PASS。只读可行性核验不满足此条件。VG-B 不是本 receipt 的前置，也不得作为其证据。
production_conditions: The CWork backend exposes an authority-semantics permission snapshot API, or an initial snapshot plus a revocation event stream, with a documented version, cursor, deny/not-found semantics, SLA and audit signature.
Real (non-test) credentials are injected through the production CWorkAuthorityProviderV1 constructor and travel only in headers; no legacy URL-query client is reused.
A real A/B visibility and revocation test is executed against two distinct non-production AppKeys with business authorization.
The production receipt signer and trust anchor are confirmed, so no FakeSigningAuthority, test sentinel or fake signer participates in any step.

If any of the above is absent, unknown or only partially demonstrated, RT-017 writes NO activation receipt at all: absence is the correct fail-closed output, and a conservative_unknown or blocked activation receipt must never be dressed up as capability_activated.
capabilities.static_note: RT-017 owns this receipt because RT-017 is the first RT that talks to the real CWork authority source. RT-024 and RT-026 are consumers only and can never produce it.

capabilities.title: Gateway 可信身份 / 受控传输
capabilities.generation_timing: Produced by RT-023 only after AC-023-01..09 are all evidenced and RT-023's own independent acceptance is PASS (T023-11), and strictly BEFORE the separate wave integration gate VG-D is executed by a different verifier (T023-12a). It binds RT-023's own PASS plus real end-to-end controlled-transport, identity and trust-store evidence, and NOTHING downstream: VG-D is neither a precondition of this receipt nor an admissible evidence role in it. VG-D remains an independent sibling input to RT-026. The order is RT-023 independent PASS -> activation receipt -> VG-D -> RT-026, so RT-023 -> activation receipt -> RT-026 stays acyclic.
capabilities.max_validity_note: 30 days, deliberately shorter than the authority capability. This one certifies a live sandbox Agent, a controlled transport endpoint and a production trust store / verifier key — all of which rotate, and a stale trust-store claim is a silent authentication bypass rather than a stale permission list. expires_at - created_at exactly equal to 2592000 is valid; 2592001 is not.
capabilities.closure_condition: 专用非生产 sandbox pilot Agent + 真实受控 transport + 不可伪造 Agent identity 注入 + production trust-store/verifier，并有 RT-023 自身独立验收 PASS。VG-D 不是本 receipt 的前置，也不得作为其证据：VG-D 是 RT-026 的独立同级输入。
production_conditions: A dedicated non-production sandbox pilot Agent exists with sandbox enabled and a minimal Tool allowlist; any Gateway restart it needs happened outside a Life-triggered turn.

At least one real controlled transport carries a real query end to end: the OpenClaw controlled Tool plugin factory, or a qualified UDS SO_PEERCRED fallback that uniquely maps one credential to one bound Agent.

Agent identity is injected by the Gateway control plane and is provably unforgeable from the request body; the sandbox cannot read the CWK instance root, credentials, shared raw or any other workspace.
The production trust store and CapabilityReceiptVerifier are loaded from the fixed root-owned path with a real Ed25519 or external KMS/HSM verifier; no test-only signer participates.

If Tool metadata cannot be proven unforgeable and no qualified UDS fallback exists, RT-023 is blocked and writes NO activation receipt; a mock-only or conservative_unknown result must never be recorded as capability_activated.
capabilities.static_note: RT-023 owns this receipt because RT-023 is the RT that builds the sandbox transport and the trusted identity chain. It is a sibling input to VG-D, not a substitute for VG-D. It is also distinct from RT-023's own per-request runtime artifact cwk.rt023.capability_receipt.v1: that one is a short-lived signed transport credential verified per call, whereas this one is the renewable current-plus-append-only-archive PR-001 activation record consumed only by RT-026.

gate_closure.static_note: VG-A passed against RT-015's FakeSigningAuthority + test-only token, so both halves of the fake — the authority/revocation source and the trusted signer identity — must be replaced by real capability before the gap closes. Both activation receipts are therefore required. rerun_allowed=false: VG-A's current receipt is frozen at synthetic=true / conservative_unknown permanently, is pinned by hash, is never rotated and never archived, and remains scoped evidence plus an explicit production caveat in the go/no-go report even after closure. A current VG-A receipt whose receipt_sha256 differs from the pin is an illegal replacement and is rejected outright.

VG-B is not expected to need synthetic providers. If its current receipt nevertheless lands with synthetic=true, the only closures are a non-synthetic rerun under receipt_history_rule and chain_rule (archive the superseded receipt under its own hash, publish a new current one linking back to it) or a prior amendment of this map adding an explicitly owned activation receipt. It may not borrow VG-A's mapping.

RT-022 freezes a fake ProfileSpaceSnapshotProviderV1 for its own core, but VG-C runs after RT-021 supplies the production adapter, so a synthetic VG-C receipt means the real adapter was not exercised and the gate must be re-run under receipt_history_rule and chain_rule.

VG-D is the gate that is supposed to demonstrate the real sandbox, real transport and real identity. A synthetic VG-D receipt is precisely the thing gateway-identity-transport activation is meant to prevent, so it must be re-run non-synthetically rather than mapped away.

Clean-room restore must be demonstrated on real backup artifacts; a synthetic VG-E receipt cannot be closed by any activation receipt mapped in this file and must be re-run under receipt_history_rule and chain_rule.

owner_scope_tree_rule: Ancestry plus owner scope proves WHEN a subject commit was frozen and WHICH package it touched, but leaves every commit that satisfies both interchangeable with every other. Each activation receipt therefore also binds owner_scope_tree_sha256 = sha256(b"cwk-owner-scope-tree-v1\0" + the sorted, NUL-terminated `git ls-tree -r -z` records under this capability's owner_code_path_prefixes at tested_subject_commit). The evaluator recomputes it from the repository, so a receipt cannot be silently re-pointed at a neighbouring commit and drift between the subject and the code the receipt describes is detected instead of assumed away.
renewal_probe_manifest_rule: A renewal at sequence k>1 is only a renewal if something was actually re-observed. Requiring the probe bytes merely to DIFFER from the previous issue's evidence is not enough: any single flipped byte in a copied file satisfies it. renewal_probe_ref must resolve to a probe MANIFEST carrying exactly capability_id, sequence, challenge, observed_at, tested_subject_commit, environment_fingerprint, api_version, result, verifier and signature, and every field is recomputed: capability_id and tested_subject_commit equal the receipt's, sequence equals the receipt's sequence, challenge is 64-hex and specific to this sequence, environment_fingerprint matches the observed environment, result is pass, verifier is named, observed_at is timezone-aware, strictly later than the previous issue's probe, no later than the evaluation instant plus activation_max_clock_skew_seconds, no later than the certifying receipt's own created_at plus that same skew allowance, and no more than activation_max_probe_age_seconds older than THAT created_at rather than older than the evaluation instant — a probe certifies a renewal at the moment of that renewal and the receipt's own expires_at is what bounds how long the certification stays good, so anchoring probe age to 'now' would have made every renewal invalid a day after it was signed and the 90-day activation TTL unreachable, and signature recomputes as HMAC-SHA256 over b"cwk-capability-renewal-probe-v1\0" + JCS of the other nine fields. The manifest must sit at this capability's sequence-specific renewal_probe_path_template, so an earlier probe cannot be replayed under a later sequence, and must have been changed by the evidence commit that introduced the receipt.
path_boundary_rule: Every prefix comparison in this map is an EXACT PATH-BOUNDARY containment test, never a raw string prefix. A reviewer showed that `str.startswith` let RT/RT-023-evil/x satisfy the RT/RT-023 prefix, so an attacker could create a sibling package whose name merely begins with the owner's and have it count as owner scope. Containment is a directory relation: path == prefix, or path starts with prefix + '/'.
evidence_commit_derivation_rule: The evidence commit E that a receipt's ancestry is checked against is DERIVED, never asserted, and it is the UNIQUE LATEST commit reachable from an explicitly injected evaluation_commit that changed the receipt path. Taking the FIRST commit that added the path (which is what --diff-filter=A returns) is wrong for a renewable receipt, because sequence 2 lives at the same path as sequence 1 and would bind the sequence-1 evidence commit. `--follow` is likewise excluded: rename heuristics are not evidence. E must have exactly one parent, since a merge can carry content that was never on the reviewed line; the blob at E must equal the blob at evaluation_commit, so nothing rewrote the receipt afterwards; and both must equal the bytes the fail-closed reader returns from disk, so the file the evaluator read and the file git recorded are provably the same file.
